method_descriptions.TRACE-MOEA: NSGA-II core + preference coevolution + budget repair + decision trace archive.
method_descriptions.R-NSGA-II: Reference-point NSGA-II using the scenario-derived aspiration point.
method_descriptions.MOEA/D: pymoo MOEA/D, Tchebycheff decomposition, penalty for budget.
method_descriptions.AHP-TOPSIS: AHP-derived weights + TOPSIS closeness ranking + greedy fill.
method_descriptions.Ablation-NoFeasibilityRepair: Repair operator disabled; constraint domination only.
method_descriptions.Ablation-NoReliabilityFeatures: Reliability objective hidden from search (evaluation unchanged).
method_descriptions.Ablation-NSGA2Only: Engine without repair, coevolution, and trace.
method_descriptions.Ablation-SmallProjectPool: Candidate pool restricted to one third.

evaluation: standard hypervolume, fixed seeded normalization bounds, ref point 1.1^d; feasible non-dominated front only
statistics: Mann-Whitney U two-sided, Holm correction per experiment
